end.chapter: Economic Geography — Natural Regions: 1. Equatorial Regions
end.title: The Equatorial Region: Location and Characteristics (Climate)
end.coverNote: Good morning, class. Today we begin our study of the natural regions with the Equatorial Region: where it is found and what its climate is like
end.notions: Equatorial region, Equator, convectional rain, humidity, annual range of temperature.
end.focus: Location of the Equatorial region; characteristics of its climate (progression sheet, week 2).
end.competence: Learners are able to locate the Equatorial region on a map and describe its hot and wet climate.
objectives: Locate the Equatorial region on a map of the world and of Africa.
Describe the temperature and the rainfall of the Equatorial region.
Read and interpret the climate graph of Yaoundé.
recall: The Equator is the line of latitude 0°.
Places near the Equator receive the direct rays of the Sun.
Southern Cameroon is covered by a thick forest.
end.recallNote: Ask learners what they know about the forest of southern Cameroon and the weather in Yaoundé or Douala.
end.justification: This lesson helps us to know where the Equatorial region is and to understand its hot and wet climate.
end.homework: Ask someone who has lived in Yaoundé, Douala or Bertoua to describe the trees and plants around the town. Write three things he or she says.
end.homeworkTag: This prepares Lesson 1 (Part 2): soils and vegetation of the Equatorial region.
